models.deep.autoencoders.vae module¶

Variational Auto-Encoder (VAE) for Time Series Prediction

This module implements a VAE architecture specifically designed for time series data, with support for multiple backbone architectures (Transformer, Mamba, LSTM, etc.)

class models.deep.autoencoders.vae.VAE(input_dim: int, latent_dim: int, d_model: int = 128, seq_len: int = 100, pred_len: int = 20, encoder_type: Literal['transformer', 'mamba', 'lstm', 'gru', 'xlstm'] = 'mamba', decoder_type: Literal['transformer', 'mamba', 'lstm', 'gru', 'xlstm'] | None = None, n_layers: int = 3, n_heads: int = 8, d_ff: int = 512, dropout: float = 0.1, activation: str = 'gelu', encoder_kwargs: dict | None = None, decoder_kwargs: dict | None = None)[source]¶

Bases: Module

Variational Auto-Encoder for time series prediction.

Architecture: - Encoder: TimeSeriesBackbone (Transformer/Mamba/LSTM/etc.) → latent mean & log_variance - Reparameterization: Sample from N(mean, variance) using the reparameterization trick - Decoder: Latent vector → TimeSeriesBackbone → reconstructed sequence

Parameters:

  • input_dim – Number of input features

  • latent_dim – Dimensionality of the latent space

  • d_model – Hidden dimension for the backbone models

  • seq_len – Input sequence length

  • pred_len – Prediction/output sequence length

  • encoder_type – Type of encoder backbone (‘transformer’, ‘mamba’, ‘lstm’, ‘gru’, ‘xlstm’)

  • decoder_type – Type of decoder backbone (defaults to same as encoder)

  • n_layers – Number of layers in encoder/decoder

  • n_heads – Number of attention heads (for Transformer)

  • d_ff – Feed-forward dimension (for Transformer)

  • dropout – Dropout rate

  • activation – Activation function for Transformer

  • encoder_kwargs – Additional kwargs for encoder backbone

  • decoder_kwargs – Additional kwargs for decoder backbone

models.deep.autoencoders.vae.vae_loss(reconstruction: Tensor, target: Tensor, mean: Tensor, log_var: Tensor, kl_weight: float = 1.0, reconstruction_loss: Literal['mse', 'l1', 'huber'] = 'mse') → tuple[Tensor, dict[str, Tensor]][source]¶

Compute VAE loss = Reconstruction Loss + KL Divergence.

Parameters:

  • reconstruction – Reconstructed output (batch_size, pred_len, input_dim)

  • target – Target sequence (batch_size, pred_len, input_dim)

  • mean – Latent mean (batch_size, latent_dim)

  • log_var – Latent log variance (batch_size, latent_dim)

  • kl_weight – Weight for KL divergence term (for beta-VAE)

  • reconstruction_loss – Type of reconstruction loss

Returns:

Combined loss loss_dict: Dictionary with individual loss components

Return type:

total_loss

Module contents¶

Autoencoder Architectures.

A collection of Autoencoder implementations for representation learning: - Vanilla AutoEncoder (AE) - Denoising AutoEncoder (DAE) - Sparse AutoEncoder (SAE) - Stacked AutoEncoder - Variational AutoEncoder (VAE)
